title: UAPI: remove __user pointers from ioctl structs
description:
Two ioctl structs embed userspace pointers, directly contradicting the stated design rule 'no userspace pointer fields in ioctl structs' and breaking 32-bit userspace on a 64-bit kernel:

  - crypto2dev_key_import_op has: __u8 __user *key (pointer to key bytes)
  - crypto2dev_list_algos_op has: struct crypto2dev_algo_info __user *algos (output array)

These require special compat_ioctl handling and are a maintenance hazard. Every future developer who adds an ioctl will copy the pattern and get it wrong.

HUMAN DECISION NEEDED — two separate choices:

KEY_IMPORT: The current CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_IMPORT_MAXLEN is 4096 bytes. Making the key inline means the ioctl struct is ~4.2 KB. Options:
  A. Inline the key at current limit (4096B in struct). Large but avoids the __user pointer.
  B. Reduce KEY_IMPORT_MAXLEN significantly (e.g., 512B for EC/symmetric; RSA keys come via a different mechanism).
  C. Keep the __user pointer but implement compat_ioctl correctly and explicitly document this exception to the no-pointer rule.

LIST_ALGOS: The output array is variable-length by design. Options:
  A. Fixed inline array of N entries (e.g., 32 entries of 96B each = 3KB struct). Simple, bounded.
  B. Enumerate via repeated read() on a special 'list' fd — avoids the struct pointer entirely, follows Unix conventions.
  C. Keep the __user pointer with correct compat_ioctl.

Work items once decisions are made:
- Update crypto2dev_ioctl.h structs
- Update ioctl handler in crypto2dev_fd.c (copy_from/to_user calls)
- Verify compat_ioctl handles all structs (run 32-bit test binary on 64-bit kernel)
- Update DESIGN.md
notes: COMPLETE 2026-04-17: All three __user pointers eliminated. (1) KEY_IMPORT: write() key bytes before ioctl, keylen field in struct — struct is now 108 bytes, no pointer. (2) KEY_EXPORT_PRIVATE: ioctl populates outbuf, read() retrieves bytes — struct is now 4 bytes (keylen [out] only). (3) LIST_ALGOS: moved to sysfs /sys/class/misc/crypto2dev/algorithms, ioctl slot 15 tombstoned. compat_ioctl block and all compat functions deleted. CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_IMPORT_MAXLEN raised to 8192 for PQ key support. inbuf/inbuf_len added to fd_state for write()-before-import accumulation. write() on UNSET fds now accepted (appends to inbuf).
